name: Job Cancel
description: Request cancellation of an existing Job. Returns its current record; terminal outcomes are preserved. Side effects already produced are not undone. For remote or delegated work, CANCELLED does not by itself prove remote execution stopped; inspect the record's delegation observations.

id.description: Exact Job ID returned by an invocation, agent request or Job listing. IDs are scoped to their hosting venue.

venue.description: Optional hosting venue HTTP(S) URL or routable DID. Omit for this venue. For a local proxy Job use its local ID and omit venue; for the destination Job use its ID and hosting venue.

authenticateAs.description: Explicit remote authentication, using the same identity and grants as the target Job. caller requires a target-audienced identity credential. venue is available only to the venue itself. Omitted venue preserves the full local caller context.

output.description: Current Job record. Optional fields retain their ordinary Job meanings, including progress, errorCode and delegation.
